# Derelict audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/derelict-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set derelict` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `hull.mp3` is cut from "de rottende veerboot" by allthingssound, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/allthingssound/sounds/425183/.
- `hold.mp3` is cut from "skibskrog.WAV" by snoezel, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/snoezel/sounds/368266/.
- `lamp.mp3` is cut from "Flickering Fluorescent Light with Background Hum (Seamless Loop, 44100 Hz Mono)" by kentspublicdomain, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/kentspublicdomain/sounds/777053/.
